name: Angel in Inferno
original_name: えんぜる・いん・いんふぇるの
source:
Four girls who committed sins during their lifetimes and died.
In the afterlife, the girls made a contract with a fallen angel and were forced to face a trial in which they would stake their “right to atone for their sins and be reborn.”
That trial involves “traveling to the past and taking actions to prevent their own sins from occurring.”

As the reasons for their deaths and their sins are revealed, the darkness and madness within the girls’ hearts are laid bare. Will the girls be able to atone for their sins...?
[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4763930/Angel_in_Inferno/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
生前犯下罪孽、命丧黄泉的四名少女。
在死后的世界里，少女们与一名堕天使缔结契约，被迫迎接一场赌上“赎清罪孽、重获转生权利”的试炼。
这场试炼的内容，便是“回到过去，采取行动阻止自己犯下生前的罪行”。

随着她们的死因与罪行逐一揭晓，深藏于少女们内心的黑暗与疯狂也随之暴露无遗。少女们究竟能否赎清自己的罪孽……？
[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4763930/Angel_in_Inferno/]Steam[/url]]
